## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (includes TypeScript checking)
- [ ] Mobile layout checked if the UI changed
- [ ] Arctic and Midnight checked if visuals changed
- [ ] IndexedDB changes use a safe Dexie migration
- [ ] Backup compatibility is preserved or the change is clearly justified
- [ ] `PROJECT.md` is updated if architecture or core behavior changed
- [ ] No credentials, private vocabulary, or backup data are committed

## Additional context

Link related issues and note any review areas or screenshots that would help.
